item.title: Error in furniture arrangement?
item.content:encoded:
I think there's a mistake in the way the pieces are arranged:

…one (1) desk currently labeled SCP-738-1, one (1) straight-backed chair currently labeled SCP-738-2, and one (1) ornate "throne" styled office chair labeled SCP-738-3…

The effect begins when a sentient entity sits in SCP-738-2 in ‘front’ of SCP-738-1 with SCP-738-3 resting behind SCP-738-2.

Based on this, it sounds like the chair is facing the desk, and the throne is behind the chair. I assume they intended the throne to be on the opposite side of the desk, i.e.

…with SCP-738-3 resting behind SCP-738-1.

I'm new here so I wanted to make a post before making any changes to the article. Let me know what y'all think.
Seems the most appropriate number of upvotes… :)

item.title: What do people think of this addition?
item.content:encoded:
Test 8:Value of soul
Result: Researcher asks what they could get for their soul. Response "That's not how this works. You don't tell me what you're willing to give, you tell me what you want first. Let's try this again shall we?" Researcher requests knowledge about SCP-████. Entity responds "Put a computer on my desk. No mouse, keyboard, or monitor are necessary. Researcher asks "What would it cost if I were to throw in my soul?". Entity responds "Do you actually believe such a thing exists?" Researcher reports Entity stared at them disconcertingly. "Huh. You actually do. How quaint. Well then, you could choose to simply live with the perpetual, unshakable belief that you are doomed to simply vanish from the world, soulless, after death" Researcher notes odd phrasing asks if souls exist. "If I knew, I wouldn't tell you, unless you were willing to pay the price of that knowledge." Researcher asks the price of that knowledge. Entity gaffaws "Your life, same as everyone else's price. You going to make a deal, or are you going to keep trying to ask probing questions to get me to reveal something about how I work? Because if it's the later, I'm going to ask you to leave now. I have better things to do." Researcher excuses themselves, and leaves room. Researcher reports entity to appear to be a rather portly rabbi.
